text: A fabulous new discovery in Berlin!  With all the restaurants to choose from, Bundesbüdchen really is a cut above the rest. Within a warm, casual atmosphere we were treated to a delicious meal - perfectly prepared old favorites with some new dishes we are happy to now call favorites, too. Kudos to chef Johann Maier for taking local German dishes to the next level. We sampled delish appetizers including the oxtail ravioli, the arctic char, and a super liver parfait nestled inside pink Roscoff onion leaves. The standout mains were the inventive red mullet and the best goulash we’ve ever tasted. Don’t miss the desserts, which were also excellent. The food was paired with excellent wine, suggested by the knowledgeable sommelier. The atmosphere and service were just right. Bundesbüdchen will now be a regular for us.

text: Berlin isn't exactly lacking in first-class restaurants. But then you suddenly stumble upon Bundesbüdchen. A prime location, a wonderfully open atmosphere, a culinary and imaginative variety from all corners of the globe – the perfect start to pure enjoyment. The very friendly and competent service also contributes to this. Admittedly, what I always look at first when visiting a restaurant is the wine list – and my mouth was already watering after just a few lines: exquisite wines, renowned winemakers, excellent vintages from the best European wine regions – all perfectly complementing the expertly crafted cuisine of the strong team, who use only the finest ingredients. My culinary highlights: the Arctic char as a starter and the red mullet in shellfish bisque with green vegetables as a main course.
originalText: Nun ist Berlin ja nicht gerade arm an erstklassigen Restaurants. Doch dann kommt man plötzlich ins Bundesbüdchen. Top-Lage, ein wunderbares offenes Ambiente, eine kulinarische und ideenreiche Abwechslung aus allen Küchen-Himmelsrichtungen - der perfekte Startschuss für den ungetrübten Genuss. Dazu trägt auch der sehr freundliche und kompetente Service bei. Zugegeben: Was ich bei Restaurantbesuchen immer zuerst anschaue, ist die Weinkarte - und da lief mir schon nach wenigen Zeilen das Wasser im Mund zusammen: edelste Tropfen, renommierte Winzer, ausgezeichnete Jahrgänge aus besten europäischen Anbaugebieten - passte alles zur handwerklich ausgezeichneten Küche des starken Teams, das nur beste Produkte verwendet. Meine lukullischen Hits: als Vorspeise der Saibling und als Hauptgericht die Rotbarbe in Krustentierbisque mit grünem Gemüse.

text:
We simply searched for a good place on Google and decided to give this restaurant a try—and it turned out to be a fantastic decision!

We were a group of seven and ordered a variety of dishes: Biryani, Chana Masala, Kadai Paneer, Chicken Tikka, Paneer Tikka, Aloo Kulcha, and Paneer Kulcha.

Starting with the starters, both the Chicken Tikka and Paneer Tikka were incredibly juicy and flavorful. After the very first bite, everyone at the table was excited and eagerly waiting for the main course.

The highlight of the meal was definitely the Chana Masala—easily one of the best I've had in Berlin so far. The Aloo Kulcha was another standout; it was absolutely perfect. The Kadai Paneer was rich and delicious as well. The Biryani could have been a little better, but it was still enjoyable and tasted good.

The food was so impressive that I completely forgot to take pictures before digging in! That's probably the best compliment I can give. I'll definitely be visiting again—and next time I'll remember to take some photos.

Not to mention, the ambience was top-class. The restaurant is beautifully designed and creates a wonderful dining experience.

Highly recommended, and we'll certainly be back!

One of the worst restaurant experiences I've ever had. The food was of poor quality, tasteless, and fell far short of expectations. Some dishes were served cold and appeared to have been prepared without any care.

The service was even worse. The staff was unfriendly, disrespectful, and reacted irritably to simple questions. At no point did I feel welcome as a guest.

Particularly appalling was the way some guests were treated, which could be perceived as racist and discriminatory. In a restaurant, everyone should be treated with respect, regardless of their background.

Overall, a very disappointing experience. Bad food, unprofessional service, and an unpleasant atmosphere. I will definitely not be returning and unfortunately cannot recommend this restaurant.

placeAddress: Schlögl's - Altberliner Gaststätte, Karl-Liebknecht-Str. 9, 10178 Berlin, Germany
text:
Today, on a day off, I stumbled upon this quintessential, somewhat hidden, old Berlin restaurant. Stepping into the picturesque, cozy dining room instantly transports you to a bygone era of Berlin, where the appropriate background music and wonderful pictures on the wall invite you on a mental journey. The menu is brimming with everything you'd expect from typical old Berlin cuisine. Naturally, there's the delicious Eisbein (pork knuckle), which I had, as well as meatballs with sides, Berlin-style currywurst with fries, kettle goulash, and Wiener schnitzel, to name just a few. And there's a separate beer menu, which showcases the various beer specialties with special pictures – a really nice touch! The food was excellent, and you can even see into the small but well-equipped kitchen (always a plus) and watch the chef at work, if you – and he – are interested. :)

Regarding the service, in Berlin, you might encounter a bit of, well, a bit of a brusque Berlin attitude in a place like this, but you won't find anything like that at Schlögl. The service is friendly, warm, and attentive, and even the chef was happy to chat when he had a spare moment. As I said, the food is top-notch, excellent value for money, no stale soft drinks, a solid espresso to follow, and if it hadn't been 4 p.m., I almost would have indulged in a Berliner Luft from one of the many attractively displayed bottles. Maybe next time. A visit to this restaurant is highly recommended. And it's so close to Alexanderplatz, where good restaurants have unfortunately become incredibly rare in recent years. If he were still able, Harald Juhnke would surely drop by now and then on his days off, enjoy a delicious meal, and order a "Herrengedeck" (a traditional Berlin drink) – true to his favorite motto, "No appointments and a little tipsy." I'll definitely be back soon.
originalText:
Ich habe heute an einem freien Tag mit etwas Glück dieses urtypische, ein bisschen versteckte, Altberliner Restaurant entdeckt. Wenn man den pittoresken, gemütlichen Gastraum betritt, fühlt man sich sofort in ein Berlin einer anderen Zeit zurückversetzt und kann sich bei der entsprechenden Hintergrundmusik und den tollen Bildern an der Wand auf eine gedankliche Reise begeben. Die Speisekarte ist reichlich gefüllt mit allem, was zu einer typischen, altberliner Küche gehört. Natürlich ein feines Eisbein, welches ich hatte, Boulette mit Beilage, Berliner Currywurst mit Pommes, Kesselgulasch, Schnitzel Wiener Art, um nur einige zu nennen. Wohlgemerkt gibt es eine eigene Bierkarte, die die verschiedenen Bierspezialitäten extra bildlich würdigt, eine ganz feine Sache! Das Essen war hervorragend, in die kleine aber feine Küche kann man direkt einsehen (so was ist immer gut) und dem Koch bei seiner Arbeit zusehen, sodenn man es - und er - möchte. :)

Zum Service, in Berlin kann es einem in einer Lokalität dieser Art durchaus passieren, auf etwas, nun ja, schnoddrige Berliner Schnauze zu treffen, nichts dergleichen hat man im Schlögl zu erwarten. Die Bedienung ist freundlich, herzlich und aufmerksam, auch der Koch war in einem freien Moment für einen Plausch zu haben. Das Essen wie gesagt top, top Preis-Leistung, kein abgestandenes Spezi, einen soliden Espresso hinterher, wäre es nicht 16 Uhr gewesen hätte ich mich fast standesgemäss zu einer Berliner Luft aus den vielen, appetitlich drapierten Flaschen hinreißen lassen. Das nächste Mal vielleicht. Ein Besuch der Restaurantion ist in jedem Fall sehr zu empfehlen. Und das ganze so nah am Alex, wo gutes gastronomisches Angebot in den letzten Jahren leider so unglaubich rar geworden ist. Wenn er noch könnte, würde Harald Juhnke bestimmt an seinen freien Tagen ab und an vorbei kommen, herrlich speisen und ein Herrengedeck nehmen - Frei nach seinem Lieblingsmotto "Keene Termine und leicht einen sitzen." Ich auf jeden Fall komme bald wieder.

placeAddress: Schlögl's - Altberliner Gaststätte, Karl-Liebknecht-Str. 9, 10178 Berlin, Germany
text: I was walking back from Kaufland and saw the sign for this restaurant at the back, with the prices and lunch menu. I found it an interesting offer, so I decided to have lunch there. I ordered a meatball with egg and fries + a small orange soda; I was served a bottle of mayonnaise with it. The food was good and the service too, until I went to pay the bill. It turned out the card machine wasn't working, so I had to pay in cash. The lady said she had hung a notice on the door; this was true, but it was in red, just like the afternoon special. So I had missed that, while the bank card logos on that same door had stood out. Perhaps a light-colored paper or a notice at the entrance would have been a better solution. So now I had to go to the ATM; I was directed to the right, but this was a Euronet ATM. This company regularly appears in programs because of the exorbitant fees they charge. So I just walked back to Kaufland, since there was a normal ATM there. I walked back afterwards to pay and the employee apologized. Because of that last part, I let her keep the change. I did ask her not to send customers to the Euronet ATM anymore, for the reason mentioned above. The bill was €18.80, so it became €20.
originalText: Kwam vanaf de Kaufland teruglopen en zag aan de achterzijde het bord van  dit restaurant staan, met de prijzen + middagmenu. Vond t een interessant aanbod, dus besloot er wat te gaan lunchen. Bestelde een gehaktbal met ei en friet + een kleine sinas, kreeg een fles mayo erbij geleverd. Eten was goed en bediening ook totdat ik de rekening ging betalen. Bleek dat de betaalautomaat niet werkte, dus moest contant. Mevrouw zei dat ze een blaadje had opgehangen op de deur, dit klopte maar was in rood, net als de middag special. Dus had die gemist terwijl de bankpas logo's op diezelfde deur wel waren opgevallen. Misschien was een lichte kleur papier of een mededeling bij het binnenkomen een betere oplossing geweest. Ik moest nu dus naar de ATM, werd naar rechts gestuurd, maar dit was een Euronet ATM. Deze firma komt  regelmatig in programma's vanwege exorbitante kosten die ze rekenen. Ik ben dus maar teruggelopen naar Kaufland, aangezien hier wel een normale ATM was. Ben daarna teruggelopen om te betalen en medewerker bood haar excuses aan. Vanwege dat laatste mocht ze het wisselgeld houden van mij. Heb d'r wel gevraagd om klanten niet meer naar de Euronet ATM te sturen, vanwege bovenstaande reden. Rekening was €18,80, werd dus €20.
ownerResponseText:
Please accept our apologies for the inconvenience. Thank you for the tip about the ATM (regarding the high fees).

Sincerely, Alexander Schlögl
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Entschuldigen sie bitte die Umstände, die sie hatten.  Vielen Dank für den Hinweis mit dem Geldautomaten. (Wegen den hohen Gebühren)

placeAddress: Das Georgische Restaurant Supra Berlin, Am Zwirngraben 6-7, 10178 Berlin, Germany
text:
After the operator attempted to delete a 3-star review with baseless accusations, here's an update to a 1-star rating:

- Any company that can't accept a perfectly normal customer review and instead takes action against it on the review platform has, in my opinion, failed to grasp the concepts of service, honesty, and feedback culture.

- The food is generally okay, but quite expensive for the portion size, and I've always found other Georgian restaurants in Mitte/Prenzlauer Berg to be tastier.

- The ambiance is chic and unique, but personally, I find the overall style too geared towards a glitzy, Instagram-worthy party. It's well-suited for large groups focused on a party atmosphere, but not so much for a regular dinner.

- The service was inconsistent. At the entrance, you're initially scrutinized by grim security, and inside, the staff are friendly and service-oriented. However, the service didn't strike me as particularly warm, personal, or hospitable.
































... Overall, it's suitable for groups and parties and therefore a definite asset to Berlin, but there's still significant room for improvement in service, value for money, and especially the feedback culture.
originalText:
Nachdem hier seitens des Betreibers versucht wurde mit haltlosen Unterstellungen eine 3-Sterne Rezension zu löschen, kommt hier nun ein Update zu lediglich 1-Stern:

- Wer als Unternehmen mit einer völlig normalen Bewertung eines Kunden nicht leben kann und stattdessen bei der Bewertungsplattform dagegen vorgeht, der hat aus meiner Sicht Service, Ehrlichkeit und Feedbackkultur nicht verstanden.
- Essen ist grundsätzlich okay, aber für die Portionsgröße ziemlich teuer und ich habe andere georgische Restaurants in Mitte/Pberg immer als leckerer wahrgenommen.
- Ambiente ist schick und einzigartig, mir persönlich ist aber der gesamte Style zu sehr auf Schiki-Micki-Instagram-Party ausgelegt. Für große Gruppen mit Party-Fokus gut geeignet, für ein normales Dinner eher nicht.
- Service war durchwachsen, am Eingang wird man zunächst von grimmiger Security gemustert und innen sind die Leute dann nett und serviceorientiert. Wirklich herzlich / persönlich / gastfreundlich erschien mir der Service jedoch nicht.

Insgesamt geeignet für Gruppen und Parties und damit für Berlin durchaus eine Bereicherung, an Service, Preis/Leistung und vor allem der Feedback-Kultur kann man jedoch noch deutlich arbeiten.

text:
I spontaneously decided to eat here. The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was very friendly and attentive. Without being intrusive, one of the waiters always checked to see if everything was alright or if we needed anything.

There seems to be a division of labor: one waiter asks if anything is needed and takes orders for things like drinks (during the meal), and another brings it.

I don't know how the seating arrangements work, as I arrived on the spur of the moment. All the waiters speak German and English. I was there with English-speaking friends and ordered in German myself. It wasn't a problem at all.

The food was beautifully presented and really delicious! There seemed to be a good selection of vegetarian dishes.

I'd definitely come back!
originalText:
Ich war sehr spontan hier zum Essen. Das Essen war super lecker, die Bedienung sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Ohne aufdringlich zu sein, erkundigte sich immer einer der Kellner, ob alles schmeckt oder etwas fehlt.
Es scheint eine Aufgabenteilung zu geben, einer fragt, ob etwas fehlt und nimmt Bestellungen auf für z.B. Getränke (während des Essens) und ein anderer bringt es.

Ich weiß nicht, wie die Platzzuweisung abläuft, da ich nachgekommen bin. Alle Kellner sprechen Deutsch und Englisch. Ich war mit Englisch sprechenden Freunden da und habe selbst auf Deutsch bestellt. Es war alles kein Problem.

Das Essen war sehr schön angerichtet, und war auch echt lecker! Es schien eine gute Auswahl vegetarischer Gerichte zu geben.

Sehr gern wieder!

text:
I rarely leave bad reviews, but this place truly disappointed on every level. The food was absolutely terrible. We started with a salad that looked like it came straight out of a plastic bag—limp lettuce, soggy cucumbers, and some random dressing splashed on top. It had zero flavor or freshness.

The main dishes didn’t redeem the experience either. The rice was dry and flavorless, the tofu was bland and drowning in a watery, tasteless sauce, and the vegetables were either overcooked or barely cooked at all. The fried items were greasy and rubbery—like they’d been sitting under a heat lamp for hours. The presentation might look passable in photos, but don’t be fooled. It was all downhill after the first bite.

Service was mediocre, and even though we were sitting outside, the table setup felt neglected and messy. Overall, this was one of the worst meals I’ve had in a long time. Definitely not worth the money or the calories.

text:
As you can see from my many reviews, I enjoy trying out new restaurants. So, I visited Viti Restaurant with my girlfriend.

We ordered a dish with seitan and vegetables, as well as duck rolled in seitan with plum sauce.

I liked the look of the restaurant, but unfortunately, the taste wasn't good. And it certainly wasn't because I'm Vietnamese. My Russian girlfriend enjoyed the food because she wasn't familiar with seitan and it wasn't cooked spicy, as she had ordered.

I can only give it two stars because the duck pieces were still quite raw, and after we complained, we had to wait a very long time for our appetizer. The side salad also lacked dressing. For me, the main course was lacking in seasoning.
originalText:
Wie man an meinen vielen Bewertungen sehen kann, teste ich gerne Restaurants. Und so besuchte ich das Viti Restaurant mit meiner Freundin.

Wir haben ein Gericht mit Seitan und Gemüse so Ente in Teg gerollt mit Pflaumensauce.

Optisch hat mir das Restaurant ganz gut gefallen, doch geschmacklich leider nicht. Und es liebt ganz bestimmt nicht daran,  dass ich Vietnamesin bin. Meiner russischen Freundin hat das Essen geschmeckt, weil sie Seitan nicht kannte und das Essen nicht scharf zubereitet wurde, wie sie es bestellt hatte.

Ich kann leider nur 2 Sterne vergeben, weil die Entenstücke noch relativ roh waren und wir, nachdem wir es bemängelt haben, sehr lange auf unsere Vorspeise warten mussten. Auch fehlte es uns bei der Salatbeilage an Sauce. Für mich schmeckte fehlten bei der Hauptspeise Gewürze.

The atmosphere, service, and food were all good, but not quite at the level one expects from a restaurant featured in the Michelin Guide. We often choose restaurants from the guide, and in the large majority of cases you leave with a strong impression — either from the food, the creativity, or the atmosphere. Here, nothing went wrong, but nothing truly stood out either.

The concept of combining classic Western dishes with Asian flavors was enjoyable, but ultimately not as special or memorable as we had expected. One aspect that could definitely be improved is the music selection, which did not really fit the overall dining experience.

We tried the 8-course menu, and while it was pleasant overall, the experience did not feel particularly unique or impressive compared to other Michelin-listed restaurants.

A truly special experience for me. Highly recommended.

Yesterday we went to MaMis Food & Wine in Berlin and opted for the "Table, Set Yourself" 10-course tasting menu with wine pairings. We spent almost three hours there – and it was a truly lovely evening.

The food was consistently excellent, and the wines were perfectly matched to the dishes. A particularly nice touch was that we could easily switch to the non-alcoholic option halfway through, as the wine pairings were becoming a bit much for us. The service was attentive, friendly, and professional throughout – a real highlight of the evening.

The individual courses arrived at pleasant intervals, and the staff always kept a watchful eye on everything. The cuisine was varied and of a high standard, but it lacked a certain wow factor for us. For a bill of €286, we had expected something a little more extraordinary.

The ambiance is cozy, but also quite small and cramped. Our table was right by the bar in the middle of the room, which took some getting used to at first – but the excellent service quickly made us forget about that.


The individual courses arrived at pleasant intervals, and the staff always kept a watchful eye on everything. All in all: a wonderful evening, great food, perfect service, and a very fitting wine pairing. Despite a few minor shortcomings in the culinary "wow factor," I'm giving it 5 stars – simply because you can tell how much love and attention goes into the work.

Wir waren gestern im MaMis Food & Wine in Berlin und haben uns für das Menü "Tischlein Deck dich" mit 10 Gängen und Weinbegleitung entschieden. Insgesamt haben wir fast drei Stunden dort verbracht – und es war ein wirklich schöner Abend.

Das Essen war durchweg sehr gut und die Weine hervorragend auf die Gerichte abgestimmt. Besonders positiv war, dass wir problemlos nach der Hälfte auf die alkoholfreie Variante wechseln konnten, da uns die Weinbegleitung doch etwas zu viel wurde. Der Service war dabei jederzeit aufmerksam, freundlich und professionell – wirklich ein Highlight des Abends.

Die einzelnen Gerichte kamen in angenehmen Abständen, das Personal hatte stets alles im Blick. Kulinarisch war es abwechslungsreich und auf hohem Niveau, allerdings fehlte für uns ein wenig der Wow-Effekt. Für eine Rechnung von 286 € hätten wir etwas mehr Außergewöhnliches erwartet.

Das Ambiente ist gemütlich, allerdings auch sehr klein und eng. Unser Tisch war direkt am Tresen mitten im Raum, was zunächst etwas gewöhnungsbedürftig war – durch den guten Service vergisst man das aber schnell.

Alles in allem: ein gelungener Abend, tolles Essen, perfekter Service und eine sehr passende Weinbegleitung. Trotz kleiner Abstriche beim kulinarischen „Wow-Faktor“ gebe ich 5 Sterne – einfach, weil man merkt, mit wie viel Liebe und Aufmerksamkeit hier gearbeitet wird.

text:
We visited MaMi’s during a special event that promised select natural wines and a special menu. Expectations were high – the restaurant is listed in the Michelin Guide and has a Bib Gourmand designation. Unfortunately, we left disappointed.

The food was okay, interesting, but nothing exceptional. However, what spoiled the whole experience was the service. After the initial order, no one came back to us – we sat with empty bottles and glasses for over 20 minutes without anyone noticing us. The tables were not even remotely occupied, so there is no excuse for being busy.

We wanted to have another glass of wine and dessert, but that was not possible either – we were not given any opportunity. In the end, I had to ask the service staff to pay for it myself. The terminal was just wordlessly placed on the table, without any interest, without asking if everything was okay. The table was left untidy, no goodbye.

For a bill of €127.50 for two people, we expected a completely different standard of service. This is really not how guests are treated in a Michelin-recommended restaurant. We are sorry. We will definitely not be back.

Jídlo bylo v pořádku, zajímavé, ale nijak výjimečné. Co však celý zážitek pokazilo, byla obsluha. Po úvodní objednávce se k nám už nikdo nevrátil – seděly jsme s prázdnými lahvemi a sklenicemi přes 20 minut, aniž by si nás někdo všiml. Stoly přitom nebyly ani zdaleka všechny obsazené, takže o výmluvě na vytíženost nemůže být řeč.

Chtěly jsme si dát ještě sklenku vína a dezert, ale ani to nebylo možné – nebyla nám dána žádná příležitost. Nakonec jsem sama musela obsluhu požádat o placení. Vedis Indian Restaurant in Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg district is one of the city's most popular Indian restaurants and makes a very good overall impression. The wide selection of classic Indian dishes, as well as vegetarian and vegan options, is particularly noteworthy. The cuisine is more modern and accessible than extremely traditional, making the restaurant especially attractive for groups, dates, or a relaxed evening.

The value for money, generous portions, and pleasant ambiance with modern decor and a cocktail bar are major pluses. Dishes like Butter Chicken, Dal Makhani, Palak Paneer, and various Biryani variations are especially popular. The Garlic Naan and Mango Lassi are also highly recommended. Anyone who enjoys Indian cuisine but isn't expecting ultra-spicy or highly regional specialties should be quite satisfied.

Overall, I would rate the restaurant about 8 out of 10: very good casual dining, a diverse menu, and a good atmosphere, even if it's probably not among Berlin's most exceptional Indian restaurants in terms of culinary offerings.

text:
Disappointing Business Lunch – Unfortunately, Not Worth Repeating

There were six of us for business lunch here. Unfortunately, the experience was disappointing overall.

The food was underwhelming: The lentil soup tasted burnt and strongly of a ready-made product/bouillon cube. It was served with soggy bread rolls, which were simply cleared away before the (very meager) main course arrived, without us even asking. The main course contained only four or five tiny pieces of meat, and the sauce left an unpleasant, greasy film on the palate.

The service was inconsistent; we received the wrong drinks, but at least they were replaced without any fuss. The ambiance itself is okay, but since the dining room was very cold, it wasn't very inviting. We unfortunately cannot recommend this place.
originalText:
Enttäuschender Business Lunch – leider keine Wiederholung wert

Wir waren zu sechst zum Business Lunch hier. Leider war das Erlebnis insgesamt enttäuschend.
Das Essen konnte nicht überzeugen: Die Linsensuppe schmeckte verbrannt und stark nach Fertigprodukt/Brühwürfel. Dazu gab es lapprige Brotecken, die zudem vor dem (sehr übersichtlichen) Hauptgang ohne Nachfrage einfach abgeräumt wurden. Im Hauptgericht fanden sich nur 4 bis 5 Stückchen Fleisch, und die Soße hinterließ einen unangenehmen, schmierigen Film am Gaumen.
Der Service war durchwachsen; es kamen falsche Getränke, die aber immerhin anstandslos ausgetauscht wurden. Das Ambiente an sich ist okay, aber da es im Gastraum sehr kühl war, lud es nicht zum gemütlichen Verweilen ein. Für uns leider keine Empfehlung.

text:
The Berlin night belonged to Otto.

Some restaurants leave you with a memorable dish, others with an unforgettable evening.

Otto belongs to the latter.

Stepping inside, there's no lavish decor, no contrived sense of ceremony; the lighting, space, and open kitchen create a naturally comfortable rhythm.

The food continues this ambiance.

Each dish is simple, yet far from monotonous. Seasonal ingredients take center stage; the cooking time, sauces, and seasonings are just right, preserving the food's most authentic flavor.

I especially loved the seared salmon—crispy on the outside, tender on the inside; the lamb was perfectly cooked, soft and layered; and the dessert provided a comfortable ending to the evening.

On my travels, I've grown to love this kind of cuisine more and more.

Without any deliberate gimmicks, you can feel the chef's respect for the ingredients from the first bite to the last.

Perhaps the truly moving aspect of delicious food lies in its quiet dedication to doing everything perfectly, without rushing to prove anything.

Tonight, Berlin.

★★★★★ Worth a reservation, and worth a return visit.

The plating alone reveals the restaurant's "less is more" Scandinavian aesthetic: seared salmon, tender pork, grilled zucchini, seasonal lettuce, handmade bread and butter, culminating in dessert—each dish is clean and crisp, devoid of unnecessary embellishment, focusing the attention on the ingredients themselves.

I've also compiled reviews from various sources, and the positive feedback for Otto is remarkably consistent:

* Michelin Selected, emphasizing seasonal and modern cuisine, with a focus on seasonal, local ingredients, and influenced by Scandinavian cuisine.

* The service team is a highlight mentioned in many reviews—professional, friendly, and able to recommend dishes and wines based on guests' preferences.

* The open kitchen and sharing menu create a more interactive dining experience, making it suitable for groups.

* The wine list is of high quality, especially the selection of natural and orange wines, which are popular with many gourmets.

* With a Google rating of approximately 4.6/5 (over 600 reviews), many travelers consider it one of Berlin's most worthwhile restaurants to book.

* In recent reviews from many international gourmets, Otto has been rated as their favorite meal during their Berlin trip, praising the high quality of every dish and the very reasonable price compared to the quality.
originalText:
柏林的夜晚，留給了 Otto。

有些餐廳讓人記得一道菜，有些餐廳讓人記得整個晚上。

Otto 屬於後者。

走進店裡，沒有華麗的裝潢，也沒有刻意營造的儀式感，燈光、空間與開放式廚房，自然形成一種舒服的節奏。

餐點延續著這份氣質。

每一道菜都很簡單，卻一點也不單調。季節食材站在舞台中央，火候、醬汁與調味恰到好處，讓食物保有最真實的風味。

我特別喜歡那道炙燒鮭魚，外皮酥香，魚肉細嫩；羊肉熟度精準，柔軟而有層次；甜點則替今晚畫下很舒服的句點。

一路旅行，我越來越喜歡這樣的料理。

沒有刻意炫技，卻能讓人從第一口到最後一口，都感受到廚師對食材的尊重。

或許，美味真正動人的地方，就在於它不用急著證明什麼，只是安安靜靜地，把每一件事情做好。

今晚，柏林。

★★★★★ 值得預約，也值得再訪。

光是擺盤就能看出餐廳追求的是「少即是多」的北歐風格美學：炙燒鮭魚、粉嫩的豬肉、炭烤櫛瓜、季節生菜、手工麵包與奶油，再到最後的甜點，每一道都乾淨俐落，沒有多餘裝飾，把焦點放回食材本身。

我也整理了各方評論，發現大家對 Otto 的好評非常一致：

* 米其林指南推薦（Michelin Selected），主打季節料理與現代料理，以當季、在地食材為核心，帶有北歐料理的影響。
* 服務團隊是許多評論共同提到的亮點，專業、親切，能依照客人需求介紹餐點與酒款。
* 開放式廚房與分享式料理（Sharing Menu），讓整個用餐過程更有互動感，也適合多人一起體驗。
* 酒單品質高，尤其自然酒（Natural Wine）與 Orange Wine 的選擇受到不少饕客喜愛。
* Google 約 4.6/5（600 多則評價），許多旅客認為它是柏林最值得預約的餐廳之一。otto
* 在近期不少國際饕客分享中，也有人將 Otto 評為柏林旅程中最喜歡的一餐，認為每一道菜都有水準，而且價格與品質相比非常合理。

text: This was my fourth visit to Otto, and unfortunately, also my worst. During my previous visits, I always felt genuinely welcomed by a warm, enthusiastic team. This time, however, the experience was disappointing from the very beginning. At the reception, I was greeted by a dark-haired hostess who may have been overwhelmed by the number of guests, but her manner felt extremely robotic and impersonal. The interaction lacked warmth and natural communication, which immediately affected the atmosphere. I chose Otto to celebrate my birthday with my partner, who is vegetarian. I wanted to order the Chef's Menu, while he had to order à la carte because it is not possible to order the chefs Menu if you are vegetarian. and then we were told that I could not have the Chefs Menu because this  is intended to be shared. The explanation given was that having one guest order the tasting menu and the other order à la carte "doesn't work well for the kitchen." What made it even more disappointing is that I visited Otto alone about two years ago, ordered the Chef's Menu by myself without any issue, and had an unforgettable experience. Concerning the food, in this last visit, the food was nicely cooked, but extreme small portions and there was a big lack of information when it was served. The hospitality, flexibility, and overall atmosphere were completely different. Instead of feeling excited to celebrate a special occasion, I left feeling disappointed. The Otto I remembered was defined not only by excellent food but also by exceptional hospitality.

Horrible atmosphere, predatory cancellation policy and hostile service – Avoid this place!
I had a deeply disappointing experience with Otto. We arrived on time for our reservation, but upon seeing that the seating arrangement (backless, unpadded bar stools, cramped and dense) was completely unsuitable for our special occasion, we politely expressed our concerns. The staff showed zero empathy, refused to offer any alternative, and acted with absolute indifference.

To our shock, we were then charged a €140 'no-show' fee, despite the fact that we physically arrived and spoke with the staff. They admitted in their correspondence that our seats were immediately given to other guests, yet they still chose to penalize us financially.

This is a predatory business practice that exploits international travelers through an automated, bad-faith cancellation policy. They care more about squeezing money out of customers than providing hospitality. If you value your money and want a welcoming dining experience in Berlin, look elsewhere. Avoid this restaurant.

text:
We dined at your restaurant and unfortunately found that our visit did not meet the usual high standards we have come to expect and appreciate. As long-time patrons, we were looking forward to a special experience, but were disappointed by several points that I would like to mention: The restrooms were insufficiently clean during our visit, which is unacceptable in a restaurant of this price range. The staff seemed overwhelmed that evening, which negatively impacted the quality of service. It was particularly unpleasant that the staff frequently walked very close to my back without any consideration for others. When a group of guests requested to add another person to their table, the communication was unclear. We were left to decide how to proceed, which put us in an uncomfortable position.

A tick was found in the salad at the next table, which was very concerning.

The asparagus was insufficiently peeled and partially burnt. The maitake mushrooms were inappropriately seasoned and had an unappetizing taste of deep-frying oil. The brownie was burnt. When we inquired, we were told it was due to "different roasted flavors," but the edge was clearly black and inedible. In total, including tip, we spent €160, which was far too much for the experience we had. It's especially disappointing because we have always highly valued your restaurant and considered it a place for high-quality meals and exceptional service. We hope you will take our feedback as constructive criticism.
originalText:
Wir haben in Ihrem Restaurant gegessen und mussten leider feststellen, dass der Besuch nicht den gewohnten hohen Standard widerspiegelte, den wir von Ihnen kennen und schätzen. Als langjährige Gäste hatten wir uns auf ein besonderes Erlebnis gefreut, wurden jedoch von einigen Punkten enttäuscht, die ich gerne anmerken möchte: Die Toiletten waren bei unserem Besuch in einem unzureichend sauberen Zustand, was in einem Restaurant dieser Preisklasse nicht zu erwarten ist. Das Personal schien an diesem Abend überfordert zu sein, was die Servicequalität beeinträchtigte. Besonders unangenehm war, dass das Personal häufig ohne Rücksichtnahme sehr dicht an meinem Rücken vorbeiging. Als eine Gruppe von Gästen die Anfrage stellte, eine weitere Person zu ihrem Tisch hinzuzufügen, war die Kommunikation darüber unklar. Die Entscheidung, wie damit umgegangen werden sollte, wurde uns überlassen, was uns in eine unangenehme Lage brachte.
Am Nachbartisch wurde eine Zecke im Salat gefunden, was sehr besorgniserregend war.
Der Spargel war unzureichend geschält und teilweise verbrannt. Die Maitake-Pilze waren unangemessen gewürzt und hatten einen unappetitlichen Geschmack von Fritteusenfett. Der Brownie war verbrannt. Auf Nachfrage wurde uns erklärt, es handele sich um „verschiedene Röstaromen“, aber der Rand war eindeutig schwarz und ungenießbar. text:
I usually come here quite often, but unfortunately, today I had a rather negative experience regarding the pricing. I ordered a currywurst, and since I'm not a fan of fries that are dry on the outside and soggy on the inside, I asked if it was possible to get fried potatoes instead. They said it was, but it would cost an extra €4.50. That wasn't worth it to me, so I stuck with the fries. The food arrived fairly quickly, but besides the already far too little curry sauce, there was no mayo for the fries. I asked if I could get some mayo, but that would have cost an extra €2.90 – which I also refused to pay. So, I ended up eating an average currywurst with too little sauce and fries that were dry on the outside and soggy on the inside, without mayo, for €15.00... I won't be coming back to eat here, even though I like it. This is how you lose regular customers just to save 5 cents on mayo.







... The cocktail selection is great, by the way (although they are rather pricey and contain relatively little alcohol). The breakfast/brunch is also worth mentioning. It was always fantastic in the past, and combined with the ambiance and pink color scheme, it was always a treat :)

I'll still come back for cocktails and breakfast/brunch, but not for the food. Any currywurst stand in the area is better and more reasonably priced. What a shame!

Ich bin eigentlich gerne und auch öfter hier, hatte heute aber leider eher negative Erfahrungen, was die Preisfindung angeht: Ich bestellte eine Currywurst und bin nicht so der Fan von Pommes, die außen trocken und innen matschig sind und fragte deshalb, ob es auch möglich sei, Bratkartoffeln zu erhalten. Dies ginge zwar, kostet aber 4,50 Euro mehr. Das war es mir dann nicht wert, blieb also bei den Pommes. Das Essen kam recht schnell, allerdings fehlte neben der eigentlich auch schon viel zu wenig bemessenen Currysauce noch Mayo für die Pommes. Ich fragte nach, ob ich noch Mayo bekommen könnte, aber die sollte nun 2,90 Euro mehr kosten - auch das sah ich nicht ein. Also aß ich eine durchschnittliche Currywurst mit zu wenig Sauce und Pommes, die von außen trocken und innen matschig waren ohne Mayo für 15,00 Euro... Ich werde also nicht wieder zum Essen kommen, obwohl ich gerne hier bin. So verliert man Stammkunden, um 5 Cent für Mayo einzusparen.

Die Cocktailauswahl ist im übrigen super (wenngleich auch diese eher hochpreisig sind und recht wenig Alkohol enthalten ist). Erwähnenswert ist zudem auch das Frühstück/Brunch. Das war in der Vergangenheit auch immer super und gepaart mit dem Ambiente und den pinken Farben immer ein Erlebnis :)

Für Cocktails und Frühstück/Brunch komme ich noch, zum Essen aber nicht mehr. Da ist jede Currywurstbude in der Umgebung besser und preislich fairer. Schade!

text:
As a frequent traveler, I've had the chance to try countless Indian restaurants in many capital cities around the world. And frankly, this one is a clear winner!

The food is absolutely excellent, the spices are perfectly balanced, and the flavors are incredibly authentic. In addition to the quality, the portions are particularly generous (ideal for refueling after a long day of walking).

If you're looking for Indian cuisine that's refined, generous, and truly transports you, go for it without hesitation. I wholeheartedly recommend this place and will definitely return on my next trip.
originalText:
En tant que grand voyageur, j’ai eu la chance de tester d'innombrables restaurants indiens dans de nombreuses capitales à travers le monde. Et franchement, celui-ci se hisse direct dans le haut du panier !
​La nourriture y est absolument excellente, les épices sont parfaitement maîtrisées et les saveurs sont d'une authenticité rare. En plus de la qualité, les assiettes sont particulièrement copieuses (idéal pour reprendre des forces après une bonne journée de marche).
​Si vous cherchez une cuisine indienne à la fois raffinée, généreuse et qui fait voyager, foncez-y les yeux fermés. Une adresse que je valide à 100 % et où je reviendrai sans hésiter lors de mon prochain passage

text:
We came here for dinner on a recommendation, and we've dined at fine dining establishments before, and the Michelin Guide is certainly familiar to us. So we were very excited to visit Restaurant Otto.

And what can I say? Despite our high expectations, the food not only impressed us, it completely won us over – exactly the kind of thing we appreciate: regional and seasonal cuisine with high-quality, fresh ingredients. Perfectly executed, without exaggeration, kitsch, or nonsense. The very friendly chef brought most of the courses directly from the kitchen to the table, after we had watched her taste the dishes at the last moment, thanks to the open kitchen, and nodded with obvious satisfaction.

The dishes are very well thought out, the individual ingredients harmoniously balanced without being overwhelming. Everything served a purpose in this symphony of flavors. The focus here is on vegetables – mostly grown in their own garden – which are presented in a way we've rarely experienced. Let me just say: the kale was the most delicious dish!!

We truly enjoyed our meal here, and the price was, in our opinion, more than fair, definitely justified, and in no way overpriced.

Thank you, dear Otto team, for giving us a wonderful evening and gaining two new fans and food lovers. We're not from Berlin, but we're here quite often and have our three or four favorite restaurants that we visit regularly when we're in town. Now there's one more on our list.

Absolutely fantastic! I give the menu 10 out of 10.

The only slight drawback was the atmosphere, or rather, the rather cramped seating, but honestly? These concerns vanished during the first course. I still hope/wish you'll be able to move to a larger location someday. Thank you for the lovely evening!
originalText:
Wir waren hier auf Empfehlung Abendessen und wir haben schon hier oder dort gehoben gegessen und auch der Michelin Guide ist für uns kein Fremdwort. So haben wir uns sehr gefreut das Restaurant Otto besuchen zu dürfen.

Und was soll ich sagen? Das Essen hat uns trotz der erhöhter Erwartungshaltung nicht nur überzeugt es hat uns komplett abgeholt - genau sowas wissen wir zu schätzen, regionale und saisonale Küche mit hochwertigen und frischen Zutaten. Auf den Punkt gebracht ohne Übertreibung, ohne Kitsch und ohne Quatsch. Die sehr sympathische Köchin hat die meisten der Gänge direkt aus der Küche zu und an den Tisch gebracht, nachdem man ihr dank offener Küche dabei zuschauen konnte wie sie die Speisen im letzten Moment nochmal kostet und sehr zufrieden nickte.

Die Speisen sind sehr durchdacht, die einzelnen Zutaten harmonisch aufeinander abgestimmt ohne überladen zu wirken. Alles erfüllte einen gewissen Zweck bei dieser Symphonie der Aromen. Hauptaugenmerk liegt hier bei Gemüse - welches hauptsächlich im eigenen Garten angebaut wird und in einer Weise in Szene gebracht wird die wir selten erlebt haben. Ich sage nur: der Grünkohl war die leckerste Speise!!

Wir haben unser Menü hier wirklich genossen und der Preis war aus unserer Sicht mehr als fair, definitiv gerechtfertigt und in keinster Weise überteuert.

Danke liebes Otto Team ihr habt uns einen sehr schönen Abend bereitet und zwei echte Fans und Genussmenschen dazu gewinnen können. Wir sind nicht aus Berlin aber öfters hier und haben unsere 3,4 Favoriten die wir regelmäßig besuchen wenn wir in der Stadt sind. Jetzt ist es ein Lokal mehr geworden.

Ganz großes Kino, ich gebe 10 von möglichen 10 Punkten für das Menü.

Einzig die Atmosphäre bzw. Das doch wirklich sehr beengte Sitzen störten etwas bei der Atmosphäre aber ganz ehrlich? Diese bedenken waren noch während des ersten Gangs verflossen. Ich hoffe / wünsche euch trotzdem dass ihr irgendwann in ein größeres Lokal umziehen könnt. Danke für den schönen Abend!

text: A wonderful and pleasant discovery in my beloved Berlin! A small, minimalist restaurant with an almost post-industrial feel, not intimate given the close proximity of the tables, but extremely welcoming. The young, enthusiastic staff in the dining room and kitchen seated us at the pass, allowing us to enjoy the spectacle of the fully open kitchen. They did everything they could to make us feel comfortable, even though it was our first time dining there. The wine list is entertaining, with more than fair markups, and the bottle of Crémant du Jura we chose was very pleasant. The cuisine is Nordic-inspired, with recipes that utilize few ingredients, dishes without frills and frills, yet decidedly enjoyable and showcasing the market's seasonal ingredients. Among the various appetizers that evening, we enjoyed an excellent bread and butter dish, a good and varied vegetarian menu, interesting catfish skewers, and the cabbage and venison roulade that was a real treat. A wonderful evening, it will definitely be a place to return to next time we're in Berlin. Thank you for making this a truly exciting and top-notch dining experience. Highly recommended!
originalText: Una bellissima e piacevole scoperta nella mia adorata Berlino! Locale piccolo e minimal in stile quasi post industriale, non intimo vista la vicinanza dei tavoli ma estremamente accogliente, ragazzi in sala e cucina giovani e con tanta voglia di fare, ci hanno fatto accomodare al pass godendo anche dello spettacolo della cucina interamente a vista e hanno saputo fare tutto il possibile per farci sentire a nostra agio pur essendo la prima volta a cena da loro. Divertente la carta vini con ricarichi più che onesti, molto piacevole la bottiglia di Cremant du Jura che abbiamo scelto. Cucina di impronta nordica con ricette che contemplano l'utilizzo di pochi ingredienti, piatti privi di fronzoli e orpelli ma decisamente godibili e capaci di esaltare la materia prima offerta da mercato e stagionalità. Per noi quella sera, tra i diversi assaggi, un pane e burro d'eccellenza, buona e varia proposta vegetale, interessanti gli spiedini di pesce gatto e da volare via l'involtino di verza e carne di cervo. Bellissima serata, sarà sicuramente un locale dove tornare la prossima volta che saremo a Berlino. Grazie per aver reso entusiasmante questa esperienza gastronomica di livello assoluto. Locale e cucina consigliatissimi!!

text:
You could formulate the review objectively and clearly:

Unfortunately, a very disappointing experience.

We had to wait about 10 minutes at the entrance before we were even shown to a table. After we sat down, we waited another 10 minutes without receiving a menu. In the meantime, several guests who had arrived after us were already being served.

When we politely inquired and pointed out the situation, we were simply smiled at and told that they were very busy. There was no apology or attempt to resolve the situation.

The behavior of the employee, Manni, was particularly disappointing. Instead of addressing the problem, she told us that we would not be served that day and should leave the restaurant.

Mistakes can happen, but treating guests with respect should be a given. Based on this experience, we unfortunately cannot recommend this restaurant.

Du könntest die Bewertung sachlich und deutlich formulieren:

Leider eine sehr enttäuschende Erfahrung.

Wir mussten zunächst etwa 10 Minuten am Eingang warten, bis uns überhaupt ein Tisch zugewiesen wurde. Nachdem wir Platz genommen hatten, warteten wir weitere 10 Minuten, ohne eine Speisekarte zu erhalten. In der Zwischenzeit wurden mehrere Gäste, die nach uns gekommen waren, bereits bedient.

Als wir höflich nachfragten und auf die Situation aufmerksam machten, wurden wir lediglich angelächelt und mit der Aussage abgespeist, dass viel zu tun sei. Eine Entschuldigung oder ein Versuch, die Situation zu lösen, blieb aus.

Besonders enttäuschend war das Verhalten der Mitarbeiterin Manni. Statt sich um das Problem zu kümmern, wurde uns mitgeteilt, dass wir heute nicht bedient würden und das Restaurant verlassen sollten.

Fehler können passieren, aber ein respektvoller Umgang mit Gästen sollte selbstverständlich sein. Aufgrund dieser Erfahrung können wir das Restaurant leider nicht empfehlen.

We will definitely be back and highly recommend BLOCK HOUSE at Alexanderplatz!

text: We ate there during our weekend getaway. We had reserved a table in advance, just to be safe. However, you can also get a table without a reservation if you're lucky. Despite there being a large group that day, our food arrived promptly. The service was excellent; we were never without drinks. The steaks were grilled to perfection, and the side dishes were delicious and fresh. The salmon was also superb. The children were also satisfied and very happy with their meals. I also appreciated that smoking was not allowed outside and everyone smoked on the sidewalk.
originalText: Im Rahmen unseres Wochenendurlaub waren wir dort zum essen. Wir hatten vorab einen Tisch reserviert zur Sicherheit. Man bekommt aber auch ohne Reservierung mit glück einen Platz. text:
We visited and opted for the "Best of" menu for €100 per person, excluding drinks.

Service:

We received a very warm welcome and excellent service. 5/5

Atmosphere:

The ambiance was okay. Unfortunately, it was very noisy, and the seating could have been more spacious. The restrooms were not up to par for the price and were also quite dirty. Interior decor is a matter of taste, but the tables looked a bit worn.

The air conditioning was also running at full blast, making it far too hot and stuffy. This is forgivable, however, as such extreme weather with temperatures above 35 degrees Celsius is not the norm. Nevertheless, expectations are naturally higher at a price of €100.

3/5

Food: The higher quality of the dishes is certainly noticeable, but whether this justifies the price is another question. Of all the dishes, the fish was the one where the higher quality was evident. All the other dishes were of acceptable quality. The combination of dishes was just okay; perhaps we arrived with overly high expectations.

While everything tasted good, anyone with prior experience in Japanese cuisine wouldn't find anything particularly surprising.

The desserts, unfortunately, ranged from mediocre to disappointing. The matcha tiramisu stands out, as aside from a dusting of matcha powder on top, it had little to do with matcha. The sponge cake was also rather dry. 3/5

Conclusion: For us, the price-performance ratio was unfortunately not right.
originalText:
Wir waren zu Besuch und hatten uns für das Best of Menü für 100€ pro Person exklusive Getränke entschieden.

Service:
Wir wurden sehr nett empfangen und super betreut 5/5

Ambiente:
Das Ambiente war okay. Leider war die Geräuschkulisse sehr laut und die Sitzabstaende hätten größer sein können. Die Toiletten entsprachen nicht der Preisklasse und waren zudem sehr verschmutzt. Innendeko ist geschmackssache, aber die Tische wirkten etwas abgenutzt.
Die Klimaanlage lief leider auch am Limit, sodass es viel zu warm und stickig war. Hier kann man aber ein Auge zudrücken, da solche Wetterextreme mit 35 Grad plus nicht die Regel sind. Dennoch ist Anspruch bei einem Preis von 100€ natürlich etwas höher.
3/5

Essen:
Natürlich merkt man die etwas höhere Qualität der Gerichte, ob dies allerdings den Preis rechtfertigt ist eine andere Frage. Von den Gerichten war der Fisch, derjenige bei dem die höhere Qualität zum Tragen kam. Alle anderen Gerichte waren qualitativ okay. Die Zusammensetzung der Gerichte war auch nur okay, vielleicht sind wir mit einer zu hohen Erwartungshaltung erschienen.

Es hat alles zwar gut geschmeckt, allerdings wenn man vorher bereits etwas länger in der japanischen Küche unterwegs war, wird man keine Überraschung erleben.
Die Desserts waren leider nur mittelmäßig bis enttäuschend. Hier ist das Matcha Tiramisu hervorzuheben, welches bis auf etwas Matcha Pulver auf Oberfläche, sonst leider nicht viel mit dem Thema Matcha zu tun hat. Zudem war der Biscuit etwas trocken. 3/5

Fazit: Für uns hat das Preis Leistung leider nicht gestimmt.

text:
The problem with Ryotei is that it tries to do more than it can. It tries to emulate Nobu and other well-known restaurants. It's very cramped, very dark, and quite loud.

The ceviche was really good, and the sushi was tasty too.

The salad with crispy shrimp was extremely basic (just a simple salad, breaded shrimp, and mayo mixed together). The steak was borderline in terms of both taste and texture.

The problem isn't that the food doesn't taste good. It does—but if you want to compete in the price range Ryotei charges, you have to offer top-notch quality in every aspect. The fish quality is excellent, but unfortunately, everything else falls short.
originalText:
Das Problem mit dem Ryotei ist, es versucht mehr, als es kann. Es wird versucht ein bisschen in die Richtung von Nobu und anderen sehr bekannten Restaurants zu gehen. Es ist sehr eng, sehr dunkel und ziemlich laut.

Ceviche wirklich gelungen, die Sushis auch lecker.
Der Salat mit den knusprigen Garnelen ist extrem Basic (Einfacher Salat, panierte Garnelen und Mayo gemischt.) Das Steak geschmacklich und Konsistenz grenzwertig gewesen.

Das Problem ist nicht, dass es nicht schmeckt. Das tut es - aber wenn man in dieser Preisklasse, die das Ryotei verlangt, mitspielen will, muss man absolute Topklasse überall anbieten. Die Fischqualität liefert ab, alles andere leider nicht.

text:
The tables are placed quite close together, and the lighting is rather dim, which may not appeal to everyone. On the evening I visited, the restaurant was also quite loud, making conversation difficult at times.
The food, however, is top-notch. The fusion of Japanese and South American flavors is creative and well executed, and the fish was exceptionally fresh. The service at the table was attentive, professional, and friendly throughout the meal.
One area that could be improved is the reception experience. For a restaurant of this caliber, I expected a warmer welcome. As a first-time guest, I found the reception staff somewhat distant, with very little greeting or introduction upon arrival, which felt unusual. In contrast, the waiters were much more engaging, professional, and hospitable.
That said, I agree with other reviews regarding the portion sizes—they are on the small side, and I left feeling slightly hungry. While the quality of the food is undeniable, I personally felt that the prices were somewhat high for what was served. Overall, an excellent dining experience with outstanding food, but one that feels a little overpriced and could benefit from a more welcoming first impression.

text: Stepping into Ryōtei 893 feels like stepping into a modern take on a classic Japanese dining room. The open kitchen hums with energy, and the ambience nicely balances refinement with approachability. The staff are genuinely attentive and incredibly gracious, making you feel at ease from the moment you arrive. Their service stands out as one of the most positive aspects of the evening, with thoughtful recommendations and timely pacing that never feels rushed.The food is a celebration of Japanese cuisine with a contemporary spin. The sushi and sashimi are fresh and expertly presented, showcasing clean flavors and precise technique. The more adventurous choices—like innovative sashimi preparations and clever fusions—provide exciting contrasts while still honoring the integrity of the ingredients. The drink pairings are well chosen, enhancing the overall tasting experience.If there’s a small room for improvement, it would be the level of consistency across the menu. Some dishes shine brighter than others, but the bar is high, and the fluctuations are mild enough to still feel like a very special night out. Prices reflect the premium dining experience, but many guests will find the quality and atmosphere worthwhile.Bottom line: for a memorable dinner with impressive hospitality and refined, inventive Japanese cuisine, Ryōtei 893 is a standout choice in Berlin. Five stars for the overall experience and the staff’s warmth, with a touch of novelty that makes it feel special rather than routine.

text: We celebrated my birthday dinner there (it was noted at the time of booking), and although the food was excellent, the overall experience was very disappointing. We arrived on time at 18:30 and were informed at the door that the table time is two hours, which is fair. We ordered and agreed with the waiter on the serving order (starters, selection of sushi/sashimi, main dish). We weren’t checking the time ourselves, as we were focused on enjoying the festive time and great food. Exactly two minutes after serving the main dish, we were informed that we needed to leave the table in four minutes. We were offered a change to the bar, but we lost both lust and appetite. I felt really sad and disappointed that instead of getting a little birthday perk, I was asked to leave the table. As we were taking pictures of everything coming to our table (visits to places like this are special for us), you can clearly see there was really poor time management on the service side. We were served aperitifs half an hour after sitting down. Only then came the first starter. The sashimi/sushi was served after 19:30, and the main dish was served a few minutes before the end of our table time. It became very stressful and not nice. The food was delicious, though. So if you want to go there, mind your watch and maybe try to avoid it for special occasions.

placeDescription: Trendy destination with a contemporary vibe doling out sushi & sashimi from an open kitchen.
text:
The moment you step inside 893 Ryōtei, your eyes need a second to adjust. Coming in from a bright Berlin afternoon, the darkness feels almost dramatic but within minutes it just feels right.

The room has this low-lit, unhurried Asian fusion atmosphere that pulls you in, and the meal that follows more than lives up to the setting. At around 180 euros for a solo dinner, it's a serious spend, but one I left feeling was earned.

I started at the bar with a Yuzu Fizz - gin & tonic with yuzu sake, lemon juice - clean, citrusy, exactly what you want to ease into a long dinner.

Then the food started arriving, and things quickly got out of hand in the best possible way. The sake toro aburi came with this gentle char that coaxed something deeper out of the salmon belly, a slightly smoky, almost buttery quality that wouldn't have been there otherwise.

Great so far. But then the tostada toro caviar arrived and reset the entire evening. One piece. A crispy tortilla base, fatty tuna belly, caviar on top. The contrast between the crunch underneath and the richness above, with the salt from the caviar tying everything together - it's the kind of thing you find yourself thinking about weeks later. I genuinely considered cancelling everything else and ordering six more.

I didn't, and I'm glad. The salmon sashimi taquitos had a quiet precision to them - heat, creaminess, fat from the fish, all in balance. The crispy ebi brought crunch and truffle mayo and a yuzu dressing that kept it from ever feeling heavy.

The miso cod won't displace the Nobu original in memory, but the glaze on the outer edges gets you close, and that's not nothing.

The server handled the whole thing well - attentive without hovering, offered suggestions when I was deciding on what to order, and generally made it feel like someone was actually paying attention rather than just taking orders. That kind of service doesn't always show up even at this price point.

893 Ryōtei isn't a casual dinner but if you're after a solo counter experience or a long table for two where the food is genuinely the point, it earns its place on that list. I cancelled the final meat course because I'd already eaten myself into a corner.

I finished with an espresso martini and walked out into Berlin extremely full and happy.

text:
There were six of us, and we ordered the large set menu. Everything was incredibly delicious, the ambiance was perfect, and the modern izakaya atmosphere was great – the quality was excellent. Therefore, it definitely gets full marks.

I do have one suggestion, though: I had read about the 10% service charge (only for groups, for the kitchen? – which is why we also gave a little extra for the excellent service) in the fine print when making the reservation, so it wasn't a surprise. However, with a total price of €1250 including some drinks, it's quite a hefty sum if you're not aware of it beforehand.

The set menu was absolutely worth it – why not include it in the menu price? A service charge like this is unusual in Germany, and I think it's good that you can usually decide for yourself what you consider reasonable.

I hope this constructive criticism is noticed despite the 5-star rating – I would appreciate a response 😊

Thank you, and keep up the good work!

Wir waren zu 6. und hatten das große Menü. Alles durchweg wahnsinnig lecker, perfektes Ambiente und modernes Izakaya Feeling, hohe Qualität. Deswegen auf jeden Fall volle Punktzahl.

Eine Anregung hätte ich dennoch: Die 10% Service charge (nur für Gruppen, für die Küche? - daher haben wir nochmal ein bisschen was für die gute Bedienung gegeben) hatte ich zwar zuvor bei der Reservierung irgendwo im Kleingedruckten gelesen, sofern kam Sie nicht überraschend. Bei 1250€ Gesamtpreis aufgrund einiger Getränke ist das jedoch schon ein Happen wenn man das nicht vorher weiß.

Das Menü insgesamt war es allemal Wert - warum nicht in den Menüpreis integrieren? So eine Service charge ist ja in Deutschland schon unüblich und am Ende finde ich gut dass man normalerweise selbst entscheiden kann was man für angemessen hält.

Hoffe diese konstruktive Kritik wird trotz den 5 Sternen wahrgenommen - würde mich über eine Rückmeldung freuen 😊

Danke Euch und weiter so!

text:
The Avocado Club in Berlin-Mitte truly lives up to its name. The concept is key: avocado is featured in almost every dish on the breakfast and lunch menu – and even in the drinks! If you're feeling adventurous, you can even try a coffee with avocado.

Food & Drinks (4/5 🥑):
Even though the concise menu might initially remind you of typical trendy Berlin breakfast spots, the Avocado Club stands out with its own unique, creative flair.

You can tell that every dish is prepared with great attention to detail. I had the "Miso Aubergine" from the breakfast selection: crispy bread with avocado, a delicate sauce, and fresh herbs, perfectly combined with grilled aubergine and red, caramelized onions – a truly successful flavor combination! The classic ginger lemonade that accompanied it was refreshing and delicious.

Service & Atmosphere (5/5 🙋🏻‍♀️ | 3/5 😍):

The service was absolutely top-notch. The staff is multilingual (German and Russian), extremely attentive, and very welcoming. Although the food took a little longer to prepare, I was proactively and politely informed beforehand – just the way it should be. At the end, they even checked to make sure everything was satisfactory. During the day, there were plenty of free tables, and choosing a seat was easy. The interior is modern and very photogenic, although perhaps a bit minimalist for some tastes.

By the way, this café is a fantastic spot for vegetarians (veggie-friendly: 5/5 🌱).

Practical Information:

💳 Card payments (debit/credit card) are accepted without any problems.

🚗 Parking is available on-site.

Conclusion: An absolute must for a stylish and delicious brunch in Mitte. The service shines with transparency and friendliness, and the kitchen proves that avocado can do more than just standard toast!

originalText:
Der Avocado Club in Berlin-Mitte macht seinem Namen alle Ehre. Das Konzept ist hier Programm: Avocado zieht sich durch fast jedes Gericht auf der Frühstücks- und Lunchkarte – und das sogar bis hin zu den Getränken! Wer mutig ist, kann hier sogar einen Kaffee mit Avocado ausprobieren.

Speisen & Getränke (4/5 🥑):
Auch wenn die übersichtliche Karte auf den ersten Blick an typisch hippe Berliner Frühstückslokale erinnert, hebt sich der Avocado Club durch seine ganz eigene, kreative Note ab.

Man merkt, dass in jedem Gericht viel Liebe zum Detail steckt. Ich hatte die „Miso Aubergine“ aus der Frühstücksauswahl: Knuspriges Brot mit Avocado, einer feinen Sauce und frischen Kräutern, perfekt kombiniert mit gegrillter Aubergine und roten, karamellisierten Zwiebeln – eine wirklich gelungene Geschmackskombination! Die klassische Ingwer-Limonade dazu war erfrischend und lecker.

Service & Ambiente (5/5 🙋🏻‍♀️ | 3/5 😍):
Der Service war absolut top. Das Personal ist mehrsprachig (Deutsch und Russisch), überaus aufmerksam und sehr herzlich. Obwohl die Zubereitung der Speisen etwas länger gedauert hat, wurde ich proaktiv und freundlich darüber vorgewarnt – so wünscht man sich das. Am Ende wurde auch noch einmal nachgefragt, ob alles zur Zufriedenheit war. Tagsüber gab es reichlich freie Plätze und eine entspannte Platzwahl. Das Interieur ist modern und sehr fotogen, wenn auch für manch Geschmack etwas minimalistischer gehalten.

Für Vegetarier ist das Café übrigens eine fantastische Adresse (Veggie-friendly: 5/5 🌱).

Praktische Hinweise:
💳 Kartenzahlung (EC-/Kreditkarte) ist problemlos möglich.
🚗 Parkmöglichkeiten sind vor Ort vorhanden.

Fazit: Ein absoluter Tipp für einen stylischen und leckeren Brunch in Mitte. Der Service glänzt durch Transparenz und Freundlichkeit, und die Küche beweist, dass Avocado mehr kann als nur Standard-Toast!

text:
Unfortunately, a very disappointing experience. We arrived at the restaurant at 12:29 pm and waited a total of 57 minutes for our food – without anything arriving. This is absolutely unacceptable, especially when you see that guests who arrived significantly later received their food after only about 15 minutes.

The worst part: Our immediate neighbors were even served the exact same food my partner ordered. It really makes you wonder how something like this can happen. I myself only ordered an omelet with toast – nothing complicated – and yet nothing arrived.

The food itself is okay, and the smoothies are good, which is why it gets one star at all. But the service was completely overwhelmed. I understand that if you're working alone and it's stressful – but then you at least have to stay organized and follow the order of service.

It was particularly frustrating to watch all the tables around us being served while we were ignored for almost an hour. That was my second visit there, because I actually liked the place – but after this experience, you seriously think twice about coming back. A definite no-go.
originalText:
Leider eine sehr enttäuschende Erfahrung. Wir sind um 12:29 Uhr ins Restaurant gekommen und haben insgesamt 57 Minuten auf unser Essen gewartet – ohne dass etwas kam. Das ist absolut nicht akzeptabel, vor allem wenn man sieht, dass Gäste, die deutlich nach uns gekommen sind, schon nach ca. 15 Minuten ihr Essen bekommen haben.

Das Schlimmste daran: Unsere direkten Nachbarn haben sogar genau das Essen serviert bekommen, das mein Partner bestellt hatte. Da fragt man sich wirklich, wie so etwas passieren kann. Ich selbst hatte nur ein Omelette mit Toast bestellt – nichts Kompliziertes – und trotzdem kam einfach nichts.

Das Essen an sich ist okay und die Smoothies sind gut, deshalb gibt es überhaupt noch einen Stern. Aber der Service war komplett überfordert. Wenn man alleine arbeitet und es stressig ist, verstehe ich das – aber dann muss man wenigstens organisiert bleiben und die Reihenfolge beachten.

Besonders frustrierend war es, zuzusehen, wie alle Tische um uns herum bedient wurden, während wir fast eine Stunde ignoriert wurden. Das war mein zweiter Besuch dort, weil ich den Laden eigentlich mochte – aber nach dieser Erfahrung überlegt man sich ernsthaft, ob man nochmal kommt. Ein No-Go.

text: We ate at Sphere in 2024 and 2026 and can therefore comment on the cuisine both before and with Tim Raue. Both times there were vegan options, and the atmosphere at the top of the TV tower is, of course, impressive. Unfortunately, we have to say that we were somewhat disappointed with our visit this year. This is in stark contrast to two years ago, when we were truly amazed by the quality. Today the food was merely okay, and the quality simply didn't justify the price. You already pay for the ride up to the restaurant, and then you're charged high prices again for what is actually quite basic food. For example, I had the vegan schnitzel with a cream sauce that was very over-seasoned and tasted acidic, and TV tower pasta tossed in margarine. It came with a small side salad. It seemed more like a child's meal than a high-quality dish for €28. The pumpkin soup as a starter was unrecognizable as such. It tasted more like tomato and bell pepper soup. However, our waiter Miguel was very friendly, as was Martin at reception. All in all, it was still a very special experience, but the quality was significantly worse than two years ago. A real shame, because according to Miguel, the chef is still the same – but now has to stick to Tim Raue's recipes.
originalText: Wir waren 2024 und 2026 im Sphere essen und können daher sowohl die Küche vor als auch mit Tim Raue bewerten. Beide Male gab es vegane Optionen und auch die Atmosphäre oben im Fernsehturm ist natürlich beeindruckend. Wir müssen leider sagen, dass wir bei unserem diesjährigen Besuch etwas enttäuscht wurden. Ganz im Gegensatz zu vor zwei Jahren, wo wir von der Qualität wirklich enorm überrascht waren. Heute war das Essen eher ok und die Qualität auch einfach nicht entsprechend der Preise. Man zahlt ja schon für das Hochfahren ins Restaurant und dann auch noch einmal hohe Preise für doch recht einfaches Essen. Ich hatte z.B. das vegane Schnitzel, dazu Rahmsoße, die sehr überwürzt und säuerlich schmeckte und in Margarine geschwenkte Fernsehturmpasta. Dazu eine kleine Salatbeilage. Es wirkte eher wie ein Kinderessen als wie ein hochwertiges Gericht für 28€. Die Kürbissuppe als Vorspeise war als solche nicht zu erkennen. Es schmeckte eher nach Tomaten/Paprikasuppe. Unser Kellner Miguel war aber sehr lieb und auch Martin am Empfang. Alles in allem natürlich trotzdem ein sehr besonderes Erlebnis, aber qualitativ wirklich um Längen schlechter als vor zwei Jahren. Super schade, denn der Koch ist laut Miguel noch der gleiche - aber muss sich nun an die Rezepte von Tim Raue halten.
ownerResponseText:
Hello Alexandra,

Thank you so much for your detailed and fair feedback. We're delighted that you enjoyed the special atmosphere in the TV Tower and the service from Miguel and Martin – we're all the more sorry that the food didn't quite live up to your expectations this year, unlike during your visit in 2024. We take your feedback regarding the vegan options and the perceived value for money very seriously and will pass it on internally, because at Sphere Tim Raue, we want to offer a culinary experience that is just as memorable as the view over Berlin.

The Sphere Tim Raue Team

vielen Dank für deine ausführliche und faire Rückmeldung. Das Sphere Tim Raue Team

text:
We were there as a family with two children and had booked online beforehand. The booking process clearly states that table requests cannot be accommodated. This is understandable, as presumably all guests want a window seat.

Upon arrival, the host gave us a card with our assigned table, which unfortunately wasn't by the window. Since there were about six or seven empty tables for four people by the window within our line of sight (approximately one-third of the restaurant), we asked the waiter responsible for that area if we could perhaps sit by the window after all. We were then informed that all the tables were about to be occupied and that he unfortunately couldn't do anything about it. (How tables are kept free when reserving window seats isn't possible remains a mystery to us. Four people are four people.) The waiter then greeted us again warmly and gave us the menus. A bottle of still water was also brought to us promptly. After we had chosen our food, I first ordered a children's meal for my daughter and then my own, at which point the waiter interrupted me and pointed at my son: "And he's not eating anything?" I replied that of course he wanted to eat something too. "And would you like to tell me what?" To be honest, I was a bit irritated that in a restaurant, the waiter was dictating the order in which I should order the different people's meals. His explanation that it was easier for him to enter the order into the system if he could select both children's meals consecutively clearly doesn't prioritize the guests' needs.

The food was really delicious. Both the children's and the "adult" dishes were excellent.

When we asked for the bill at the end, only one of the six or seven previously empty four-person window tables was occupied; all the others remained empty. When I mentioned this to the waiter, he simply reiterated that there was nothing he could do about it; that's how the system worked. I think that something could certainly be done there. The only question is whether the service staff would be willing to do so.

As a result, the children spent most of the time standing between the empty tables by the window, looking out, while we parents sat separately at our table.

With prices of €28 for a black pudding and a "basic fee" of €76 for two adults and two children just to enter the restaurant, one would expect appropriate service. Unfortunately, we didn't find this to be the case during our visit.
originalText:
Wir waren als Familie mit zwei Kindern dort und hatten zuvor online gebucht. Bereits bei der Buchung wird darauf hingewiesen, dass keine Platzwünsche angenommen werden können. Das ist verständlich, da mutmaßlich alle Gäste einen Fensterplatz wünschen.
Vor Ort erhielten wir vom Host dann ein Kärtchen mit dem zugewiesenen Tisch, welcher sich leider nicht am Fenster befand. Da in unserem Blickfeld (ca. 1/3 des Restaurants) etwa 6-7 4er-Tische am Fenster frei waren, fragten wir den für diesen Bereich zuständigen Kellner, ob wir nicht vielleicht doch am Fenster sitzen könnten. Daraufhin wurde uns mitgeteilt, dass gleich alle Tische belegt sein würden und er da leider nichts machen könne. (Wie es dazu kommt, dass Tische freigehalten werden, obwohl eine Reservierung der Fensterplätze nicht möglich ist, erschließt sich uns bis jetzt nicht. 4 Personen sind 4 Personen.)
Der Kellner begrüßte uns dann zunächst nochmal freundlich und gab uns die Menükarten. Auch eine Flasche stilles Wasser wurde uns zügig gebracht. Nachdem wir unser Essen ausgewählt hatten, bestellte ich zunächst ein Kindergericht für meine Tochter und danach mein eigenes, woraufhin mich der Kellner unterbrach und auf meinem Sohn deutete: „Und er isst nichts?“. Daraufhin sagte ich, dass er natürlich auch etwas essen wolle. „Und wollen Sie mir auch sagen was?“ Hier war ich ehrlicherweise etwas irritiert, dass mir in einem Restaurant vom Kellner vorgegeben wird, in welcher Reihenfolgen ich die Speisen der verschiedenen Personen bestellen soll. Die Begründung, dass das im Bestellsystem für ihn leichter einzugeben sei, wenn er beide Kindergerichte hintereinander anklicken könne, stellt offensichtlich nicht die Gäste in den Mittelpunkt des Servicegedanken.

Das Essen hat wirklich sehr gut geschmeckt. Sowohl die Kinder- als auch die „Erwachsenen“-Gerichte haben durchweg überzeugt.

Als wir am Ende die Rechnung orderten, war von den zuvor 6-7 freien 4er-Fenstertischen genau ein Tisch belegt, alle anderen weiterhin frei. Als ich den Kellner darauf ansprach, meinte er erneut nur, dass er da nichts machen könne, das gebe das System vor. Ich denke, dass man dort selbstverständlich „etwas machen könnte“. Die Frage ist nur, ob man als Service-Mitarbeiter dazu bereit ist.
So haben die Kinder die meiste Zeit zwischen den leeren Tischen am Fenster gestanden und hinausgeschaut, während wir Eltern getrennt davon am Tisch saßen.

Bei Preisen von 28€ für eine Blutwurst sowie einer „Grundpauschale“ von 76€ für 2 Erwachsene + 2 Kinder, um das Restaurant überhaupt betreten zu können, kann man einen passenden Service erwarten. Diesen haben wir bei unserem Besuch aber leider vermisst.

The breakfast was okay, but nothing special. There was salmon with a little horseradish, sausage, ham, cheese, mini pastries, butter, and Darbo jam. A standard hot drink was included.

My conclusion – better to have breakfast at a restaurant on the ground floor and then go upstairs and enjoy the view.

text:
We deliberately opted against the hotel breakfast and were looking forward to the Highest Breakfast. Unfortunately, it was a disappointment.

We like to spend money on good food. However, the breakfast at the Sphere was sadly reminiscent of a fast-food chain and didn't even come close to meeting our expectations, let alone justifying the price.

It wasn't just the quantity of food that was disappointing. Without any opportunity to choose, a tiered tray was presented containing three slices of salami, a slice of cooked ham that resembled discount store fare, a small bowl of sweet mustard (under which was a hint of liverwurst), and a small selection of cheeses. The cheese selection consisted of a slice of semi-hard cheese, a small piece of blue cheese, a slice of goat cheese, and a piece of soft cheese. I don't like either goat cheese or blue cheese. Soft cheese wasn't to my taste either.

It would have been nice to at least have the option of having some say in what was on the tray.

A boiled or scrambled egg was available for an extra charge.

The included filter coffee was fine. Unfortunately, water was neither offered nor served.

I'm well aware that running a restaurant in this location presents a certain logistical challenge. But at €39, I expect more than the standard fare offered. This was very disappointing and frustrating. This is especially true when, given the limited portion size, you have to send food back because you don't like it or don't want it. At least the "Highest Breakfast," which this review specifically refers to, is not worth recommending and felt a bit like a rip-off. A shame.
originalText:
Wir hatten uns bewusst gegen das Hotelfrühstück entschieden und auf das Highest Breakfast gefreut. Leider war es eine Enttäuschung.
Wir geben gerne Geld für gutes Essen aus. Das Frühstück im Sphere erinnerte aber bedauerlicherweise sehr an Systemgastronomie und entsprach nicht ansatzweise den Erwartungen und schon gar nicht dem dafür aufgerufenen Preis.
Dabei war es nicht nur die Quantität des Servierten, die enttäuschte. Ohne die Möglichkeit einer Einflussnahme wurde ein Etagere serviert, auf welcher sich drei Scheiben Salami, eine Scheibe Kochschinken, die an Discounter-Ware erinnerte sowie ein Schälchen mit süßem Senf, unter welchem sich ein Hauch Leberwurst versteckt hielt, und eine kleine Käseauswahl befanden. Die Käseauswahl bestand aus einer Scheibe Schnittkäse, einem kleinen Stück Blauschimmelkäse, einer Scheibe Ziegenkäse und einem Stück Weichkäse. Ich mag allerdings weder Ziegenkäse noch Blauschimmelkäse. Auch Weichkäse entsprach nicht meinem Geschmack.
Es wäre nett gewesen, wenn man zumindest die Möglichkeit bekommen hätte, den Inhalt der Etagere wenigstens ein bisschen mitzubestimmen.
Ein gekochtes Ei oder Rührei war gegen Aufpreis erhältlich.
Der im Preis inbegriffene Filterkaffee war in Ordnung. Wasser wurde dazu leider weder angeboten noch serviert.

Mir ist durchaus bewusst, dass ein Restaurant an dieser Örtlichkeit eine gewisse logistische Herausforderung darstellt. Aber bei einem Preis von 39€ erwarte ich mehr als die dargebotene Systemgastronomie. Das war sehr schade und auch ärgerlich. Dies gilt insbesondere dann, wenn bei der überschaubaren Menge des Servierten wieder zurückgeht, weil es nicht schmeckt bzw. man es nicht mag. Zumindest das Highest Breakfast, worauf sich diese Bewertung explizit bezieht, ist keine Empfehlung wert und fühlte sich ein bisschen nach Abzocke an. Schade.
