text:
A wonderful Christmas, thank you so much! From the greeting and subsequent seating, through ordering and the accompanying continuous service (absolutely professional), right up to our departure, we were treated with the utmost care. A small selection: Starter: Gillardeau oysters (always a bonus when I get them), foie gras - Main course: Sea breeze, surf and turf, halibut, duck breast and leg - Dessert: Classic apple strudel, crème brûlée, and chocolate mousse. Absolutely top-notch, both in terms of taste and temperature, no waiting time, very discreetly keeping an eye on everything and ensuring that our glasses were refilled. Thank you for this wonderful evening. Until next year. We wish you a merry, healthy, happy, peaceful, and blessed Christmas. For years, our visit to the Gendarmerie has been one of the special culinary highlights of the year for our family. Even though we only visit twice a year, each time we feel not just like guests, but welcomed like trusted regulars. Especially in a capital city restaurant with a high volume of international clientele, this kind of personal attention is anything but a given and deserves special recognition.

The restaurant's ability to maintain a familial, almost intimate atmosphere despite the often enormous number of guests is particularly impressive. Being recognized, receiving a warm and attentive welcome, and yet experiencing a completely professional service culture testifies to excellent personnel management and genuine hospitality at the highest level.

The combination of stylish ambiance, impeccable organization, and a pleasantly understated elegance makes every visit an exceptional experience. Here, one doesn't get the impression of standardized fine dining, but rather that rare character of an establishment that understands that true quality isn't solely found on the plate, but above all in the interpersonal interaction. The culinary standard remains consistently high, but what truly distinguishes this restaurant from many others is the palpable consistency in attention, friendliness, and appreciation for its guests. It is precisely these details that leave a lasting impression and ensure that one looks forward to the next visit even before leaving.

For us, the Gendarmerie is far more than a restaurant visit – it is a place of refined hospitality, reliability and special moments in the heart of Berlin.
originalText:
Ein wunderschönes Weihnachtsfest, vielen herzlichen Dank. Von der Begrüßung und anschließenden Platzierung über die Bestellung und den damit verbundenen durchgehenden Service (absoluter Profi) bis hin zum Abschied wurden wir herzlichst bewirtschaftet. Ein kleiner Auszug: VS: Gillardeau Austern (immer ein Plus, wenn ich sie bekomme), Foie Gras - HS: Meeresbriese, Surf- and Turf, Heilbutt, Entenbrust und -keule - NS: Klassischer Apfelstrudel, Creme Brulee und Schokomousse. Tip top, geschmacklich und auch perfekt temperiert, keine Wartezeit, sehr dezent immer alles  im Auge behalten und dafür gesorgt das nachgeschenkt wurde. Danke für diesen wunderbaren Abend. Bis zum nächsten Jahr. Frohe, gesunde, glückliche, besinnliche und gesegnete Weihnachtsfeiertage wünschen wir euch. Unser Besuch im Gendarmerie gehört für unsere Familie seit Jahren zu den besonderen kulinarischen Momenten des Jahres. Auch wenn wir das Haus lediglich zwei Mal jährlich besuchen, entsteht dort jedes Mal aufs Neue das Gefühl, nicht einfach Gäste zu sein, sondern willkommen geheißen zu werden wie vertraute Stammgäste. Gerade in einer Hauptstadtgastronomie mit hohem internationalen Publikumsverkehr ist diese Form persönlicher Aufmerksamkeit alles andere als selbstverständlich und verdient besondere Anerkennung.
Besonders beeindruckend ist die Fähigkeit des Hauses, trotz der oftmals enormen Anzahl an Gästen eine familiäre, beinahe intime Atmosphäre aufrechtzuerhalten. Wiedererkannt zu werden, aufmerksam und herzlich empfangen zu werden und dabei dennoch eine vollkommen professionelle Servicekultur zu erleben, zeugt von exzellentem Personalmanagement und echter Gastgeberschaft auf höchstem Niveau.
Die Verbindung aus stilvollem Ambiente, souveräner Organisation und einer angenehm unaufdringlichen Eleganz macht jeden Aufenthalt zu einer außergewöhnlichen Erfahrung. Hier entsteht nicht der Eindruck standardisierter Spitzengastronomie, sondern vielmehr jener seltene Charakter eines Hauses, das verstanden hat, dass wahre Qualität nicht allein auf dem Teller stattfindet, sondern vor allem im zwischenmenschlichen Umgang.
Kulinarisch bewegt sich das Niveau konstant auf höchstem Standard, doch was dieses Restaurant wirklich von vielen anderen Adressen unterscheidet, ist die spürbare Kontinuität in Aufmerksamkeit, Freundlichkeit und Wertschätzung gegenüber den Gästen. Genau diese Details bleiben langfristig in Erinnerung und sorgen dafür, dass man sich bereits während des Besuchs auf den nächsten freut.
Die Gendarmerie ist für uns weit mehr als ein Restaurantbesuch – sie ist ein Ort der gepflegten Gastlichkeit, der Verlässlichkeit und der besonderen Momente im Herzen Berlins.

The dessert (crème brûlée and apple strudel) was tasty, but nothing special. For the price, I would probably skip it.

placeDescription: Artfully presented French brasserie cuisine, in a stylish space decorated with large-format art.
text:
We were here on Sunday, December 28th, and our experience was unfortunately very disappointing. The service was poor and very pushy, especially one man (about 30-35 years old, dark hair, glasses) didn't seem professional.

We ordered a Fanta, which was initially placed at another table. The glass was then taken from that table and poured for us. The glass was then held on top, which is absolutely unacceptable for hygiene. This immediately made us feel uncomfortable.

When taking our order, the service was also pushy. We were asked if we wanted fries, but this was written down before we could answer, in an unfriendly tone. That shouldn't happen.

We ordered bread with herb butter. The bread arrived initially with some oil and pepper, but the herb butter arrived much later, at the same time as the main course, and was rock hard (clearly fresh from the refrigerator).

The food itself was very tasty, so compliments to the kitchen. Unfortunately, that couldn't make up for the poor service. The waiters seemed irritated among themselves, sighed frequently, and didn't seem to enjoy their work, which didn't improve the atmosphere.

When paying, they also insisted on tipping, even though the service didn't warrant it. Furthermore, the hygiene and personal grooming of one of the waiters didn't seem very good.
originalText:
Wij waren hier zondag 28 december en onze ervaring was helaas erg teleurstellend. De bediening was slecht en erg opdringerig, met namen een man (ongeveer 30–35 jaar, donker haar, bril) maakte geen professionele indruk.

Wij bestelden een Fanta, die eerst bij een andere tafel werd neergezet. Dat glas werd daarna van die tafel afgepakt en alsnog bij ons ingeschonken. Daarbij werd het glas bovenop vastgepakt, wat hygiënisch echt niet kan. Dit gaf ons direct een ongemakkelijk gevoel.

Bij het opnemen van de bestelling werd er ook dwingend gehandeld. Er werd gevraagd of we friet wilden, maar dit werd al opgeschreven voordat we konden antwoorden, met een onvriendelijke toon. Dat hoort niet zo te gaan.

We bestelden brood met kruidenboter. Het brood kwam eerst met wat olie en peper, maar de kruidenboter kwam pas veel later, tegelijk met het hoofdgerecht, en was keihard (duidelijk net uit de koelkast).

Het eten zelf was wel erg lekker, dus complimenten aan de keuken. Helaas kon dat de slechte service niet goedmaken. De obers leken onderling geïrriteerd, zuchtten veel en straalden weinig plezier uit in hun werk, wat de sfeer niet ten goede kwam.

Bij het afrekenen werd er ook erg aangedrongen op het geven van fooi, terwijl de service daar voor ons geen aanleiding toe gaf. Daarnaast maakte de hygiëne en persoonlijke verzorging van één van de obers geen frisse indruk.

placeDescription: Artfully presented French brasserie cuisine, in a stylish space decorated with large-format art.
text:
The location is beautiful and inviting. The service was generally adequate, without being particularly outstanding. Unfortunately, the dishes were underwhelming and only mediocre in taste. However, the most disappointing aspect is the inclusion of foie gras on the appetizer menu. This form of animal cruelty has been known and heavily criticized by society for years – to still offer it as a delicacy today seems outdated and completely out of touch.

text:
We've eaten here three times over the years, and it was great every time. Last time, we had a fantastic set menu with wine pairings. The food was truly excellent, and the wine pairings were perfectly chosen. The service was top-notch, unobtrusive, and very friendly. The atmosphere was very pleasant. The background music was some of the best I've heard in a long time (80s hits), not the usual boring electronic music from DJs who never even eat in a restaurant like this. We arrived very late and were the last guests, but the staff never pressured us to pay or leave. We felt welcome and valued (something I've often experienced at the Hotel de Rome; the service is better than in some other hotels in Berlin). We'd come back anytime.

Oh, and since someone complained about the Negroni in the reviews (you could have sent it back if it wasn't to your liking), I also had one, and it was absolutely perfect and well-balanced (many people tend to make them too bitter). The four of us had a great evening.

text: My friends and I did not eat in the restaurant but rather had a few drinks at the bar on a Saturday night. We sat on bar stools at the bar, met some nice & interesting people and enjoyed our good but expensive cocktails. What struck me as disproportionate was the complete lack of attention from the bar team. Granted, they are very busy with all the orders from the bar and restaurant, but being ignored, never eye contact, never asking if we need anything - not the experience I had expected from this so-called classy establishment. I was a bartender for many years and I know that eye contact and communication with those sitting at the bar is not only essential but in the interest of the establishment's reputation. Not to mention it is simply part of the job. Kudos to the one bartendress who actually spoke to us & smiled.
